options.text: Each student's own handspan is suitable, because a body part is always a standard unit.
The metre is suitable, because everyone can use the same agreed length.
A standard length unit must be the same for every student who shares the measurement.
No shared length unit is possible, so each desk must keep its own private unit.

stem:
Tara's class must share one length unit when they measure the same desk. Someone suggests each student's own handspan. Someone suggests the metre.

Which claims correctly decide whether a length unit is suitable as a standard unit? One or more options may be correct.

teacher.key_rationale: A standard unit is an agreed shared length, such as the metre. Personal handspans differ, so they are not suitable as the shared standard.
